name: Northwind Coffee
product: Fictional example brand: freshly roasted beans on a monthly subscription, flexible pauses, personal roast recommendations. Exists purely as a structural template for real brands under brands/<slug>/.
guardrails: No invented social proof, no invented testimonials
No false urgency or invented scarcity
No competitor bashing; factual comparison is fine
Real em-dash-free customer copy; sell the result, not the mechanism

forbiddenPatterns.reason: No em dashes in customer-facing copy (use a comma, colon, or new sentence)
Sell the result and the relief, not the mechanism
CTAs are outcome-oriented with an object (e.g. Browse the sampler pack)
No competitor bashing via fighting words

cta.label: Get your sampler pack
cta.subline: Try it without commitment. Pause or end the subscription anytime.

fallbackCopy.message: Freshly roasted coffee, delivered monthly: Northwind Coffee matches beans to your taste. Pause or cancel anytime.
fallbackCopy.headline: A coffee subscription that fits your taste

designTokens.imagery: Warm daylight, real kitchen and café scenes, no stock poses
